summary: The documents related to MaintProgramProfileInvoiceRates primarily describe the user control for maintaining program profile invoice rates within the HSPnet platform. It includes definitions of web controls, event handlers, and methods for managing invoice rates, including adding, editing, and deleting rate entries.
purpose: To enable users to manage invoice rates associated with program profiles within the HSPnet platform.

workflows.name: Invoice Rates Management
steps: Bind data to uxMaster GridView and manage row actions
HandleItem commands for adding, editing, and deleting rates
Manage session caching and page redirects

business_rules: Invoice rates can only be managed when UserSession is active.

calculations: Parsing and validating currency rates from user input.
